assessment: This report provides a useful characterization of the behaviors evoked by a Pavlovian conditioned stimulus (CS) paired with foot shock in male and female rats. The aim of the study was to assess the generalizability of the authors' past findings (Chu et al., 2024), established using an auditory CS (a tone), to a visual CS (a light). The reviewers appreciated the extensive nature of the task undertaken: there was agreement that the methods and analyses used to produce the study findings are solid. This work will be of interest to those who study associative learning, fear, ethological assessment, and behavior more broadly.
